metadata.title: TIPRA Motha : Will form the Government, Not the Kingmaker | Tripura Elections | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: TIPRA Motha is a relatively new political outfit in Tripura politics. But this party has got every body's attention when it defeated the ruling coalition of BJP and IPFT in Autonomous District Council elections. Now state is going to poll on 16 February, and this party is challenging ruling combination of BJP-IPFT and CPI(M)-Congress.
